{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS061 |prevtitle=Breath of the Dragonair Part 2 |nextcode=PS063 |nexttitle=Extricated from Exeggutor |series=Yellow |colorscheme=Yellow}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=Breath of the Dragonair Part 3 |title_ja=VS ハクリュー【後編】 |title_ro=VS Hakuryu (Part 3) |image=PS062.png |scheme=Yellow |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 62 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|5}} |pub2=VIZ Media monthly issue |pub2-data=Chapter 22 in [[Dratini Of The Deep]] |pub3=VIZ Media full volume |pub3-data=Adventure 62 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|5}} |location={{DL|Vermilion City|Port|Vermilion Harbor}} }} '''Breath of the Dragonair Part 3''' (Japanese: '''VS ハクリュー【後編】''' ''VS {{tt|Hakuryu|Dragonair}} (Part 3)'') is the 62nd chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 22nd chapter of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} [[Lance]] throws [[Pika]] back to {{Adv|Yellow}} and has his {{p|Dragonair}} {{m|wrap}} around Yellow, immobilizing Yellow. He tells Yellow that he is in the [[Elite Four]] and can control {{t|Dragon}}s. To prove this, he commands his Dragonair to {{m|Rain Dance|put thunderclouds into the sky}}. Pika tries to attack Lance, but stops when Dragonair's {{m|Hyper Beam}} narrowly misses it. The beam then changes direction and hits Pika. It falls into the ocean. Lance reassures Yellow that he held back, so Pika won't die. He then sees the scar on Pika's ear, and he knows that the {{p|Pikachu}} is Pika. The Elite Four has found Pika. Lance's Dragonair drops Yellow and wraps around Pika. Yellow tells Pika to use {{m|Substitute}}, and Pika creates a double that attacks Lance but misses. Enraged, Lance has his Dragonair use {{m|Dragon Rage}}, and Dragonair blasts Yellow, Pika, and its double, making them fall into the ocean. While underwater, Yellow notes that Pika's double repels water, and gets an idea. Lance hears something, and he turns around to see Yellow surfing with the help of Pika who had learned {{m|Surf}}. Pika uses {{m|Thunderbolt}} on Lance, causing a giant explosion and Lance to disappear. Yellow, having apparently defeated Lance, starts to go to "[[Cinnabar Island|the city at the other end of the sea]]". Behind Yellow, bubbles start to rise to the water's surface. ==Major events== * [[Pika]] learns to {{m|Surf}}. * {{adv|Yellow}} battles [[Lance]] of the [[Kanto]] [[Elite Four]] and seemingly defeats him. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Red}} (flashback) * {{adv|Yellow}} * {{adv|Professor Oak}} * {{adv|Bill}} (flashback) * [[Lorelei]] (flashback) * [[Lance]] * {{tc|Super Nerd}} {{adv|Miles}} (flashback) ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Pidgeot}} ({{adv|Blue}}'s) * {{p|Rattata}} ([[Ratty]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s; flashback) * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Pika]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Dragonair}} ([[Lance]]'s) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{yellow color light}}|bordercolor={{yellow color}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 哈克龍[後篇]|VS Dragonair (last part)}} (Taiwan)
